# HEM v0.8.5

Room tabs now align the condition face just after the widest room name. Warnings, missing-data indicators and active-device icons sit together. Live updates preserve the focused room control when a room is added, renamed or reordered. Sensor charts show the configured limit when its unit matches the reading.

A selected person or device tracker reporting Home now supplies household presence to room planning and controller checks, even with distance rules disabled. You can clear the final proximity tracker and keep the saved radii for later.

Large equipment updates give Home Assistant time between batches of state writes. Each native room sensor now assesses only its own room, and live dashboard updates reuse the installed card styles. A prolonged dashboard or device-registry outage stops scheduling retries after six timed attempts. A later Home Assistant update can resume the connection.
